summary.headline: Weighing Astrological Indications
summary.text: Astrological judgment guidelines for weighing planetary aspects and conditions, including acceptance, rejection, pushing, besiegement, interception, frustration, mutual aspects, returns, retrogradation, direction, exaltation, fall, cazimi, combustion, and heliacal setting. The text cites the Part of Events, Birjandi’s commentary on the Twenty Chapters, Mercury’s return, the Moon in Scorpio, and the precedence of universal annual and seasonal ascendants over particular indications.
